newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -Dollar/yen seen range-bound in Asia.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Dollar/yen seen range-bound in Asia.

text.p: The dollar is expected to be steady against the yen in range-bound Asian trade on Tuesday, and traders said overnight remarks by Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto were unlikely to have further impact here.

Hashimoto said on Monday in New York he would like the United States to cooperate in stabilising foreign exchange rates because currency volatility might cause Japan to sell its holdings of U.S. government securities and switch to gold.
His remarks sent U.S. financial markets into turmoil, but a trust bank dealer said they were unlikely to be taken seriously in Tokyo.
